text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service `shared-db-connections` (severity: P1) — Postgres max_connections reached; concurrent Redis clients spiking. Metrics: pg_connections=500/500, redis_clients=10000/10000; 5xx errors rising on /api/v1/generate. Runbook: <https://rwd.internal/runbooks/db-connection-surge>

pagerduty: Incident created: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345 — notify: on-call, escalation policy: shared-db

alex: ack — taking lead. grabbing current graph panels now. will post immediate mitigation steps.

maria: I'm seeing a lot of TIME_WAIT sockets on app pods, connection pool saturation on pgbouncer metrics too. App-side pools are at max. :grimacing:

leo: confirming Redis `maxclients` is hit on cluster redis-primary-1. backlog increasing. clients blocked in `BRPOPLPUSH` heavy workloads.

nia: Customer-facing errors: ~2.3% 500 rate for write-heavy endpoints, SLO is 0.1%. Several enterprise customers reporting increased latency.

alex: quick mitigation plan (in order):
1) throttle background jobs (disable heavy queues)
2) temporarily scale up DB read-replicas and route non-critical read traffic
3) increase Postgres `max_connections` by 50 (if we have headroom on memory) OR restart idle sessions
4) bump pgbouncer pool size (short term) and enable client connection pooling where possible
5) for Redis, evict long-lived clients (identify blocking clients) and increase `maxclients` if safe

maria: executing step 1: pausing job queue `embedding-batch` via admin UI now. :white_check_mark:

sam: I can scale app frontend pods to shed some connection load, starting +4 replicas. patching HPA now.

alex: checking pg_stat_activity to identify stale sessions. Running:
```sql
-- find long idle connections > 5m
SELECT pid, usename, application_name, client_addr, state, now() - state_change AS idle_time, query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state = 'idle' AND now() - state_change > interval '5 minutes';
```

alex: kill plan (will terminate idle only):
```sql
-- terminate candidate pids
SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state = 'idle' AND now() - state_change > interval '15 minutes';
```

leo: For Redis, listing clients now: `redis-cli -h redis-primary-1 CLIENT LIST` — will target clients showing high `idle` and `cmd=BRPOPLPUSH`.

nia: marking impacted customers: team-sales notified, CS on standby. adding incident tag `customer-impact:partial`.

pagerduty: alex acknowledged the incident at 2050012347. Escalation timer paused.

maria: paused heavy jobs success. pgbouncer pools still saturated though, because app pools didn't release fast enough.

sam: frontend replicas +4 applied; new pods are booting, expected to drop connection pressure in ~30s.

alex: executing `pg_terminate_backend` for 27 idle pids (age >15m). monitoring connection count. logs:
```
NOTICE: terminating backend pid 12345
NOTICE: terminating backend pid 12346
```

alex: Postgres connections dropped to 420/500 — still elevated but no longer at max. Application 5xx rate dropping from 2.3% -> 0.6%.

leo: Redis: killed 12 blocking clients tied to legacy worker nodes. `maxclients` still at 10000; memory headroom is OK to increase by 500 if needed.

nia: CS update: major customer A saw degraded request throughput for ~9 minutes, recovery trending. logging the incident for SLA review.

maria: pgbouncer stats: avg wait queue length decreased from 40 -> 6. Pooling adjustments holding.

alex: temporary DB config changes: increased `max_connections` by 50 (from 500 -> 550) via immediate parameter apply on staging-like host (we have automation to roll on primaries). Keeping watch on memory.

sre-rotation: note — since we bumped max_connections, watch for shared_buffers OOM risk. Set alert: free_memory < 10%.

sam: frontend pods are healthy; connection churn reduced. 5xx now at 0.12% and falling.

alex: next steps: schedule a follow-up to tune pgbouncer and app pool sizes; evaluate connection pooling client-side; create a runbook addendum for mixed Postgres+Redis saturation events.

maria: creating incident ticket now: INC-2025-084 — adding timeline, mitigation steps, customer impact, and owners. assigning to alex for RCA.

pagerduty: incident status changed to acknowledged -> monitoring (PD12345) at 2050012360.

leo: suggestion: investigate long BRPOPLPUSH patterns in background workers — consider replacing with streams consumer pattern to reduce blocking clients.

nia: putting a short note for account teams: email template drafted, waiting on final impact numbers.

alex: handing off to night oncall at 2050012380 — nia will be primary. I'll remain on-call for any followups. Handoff checklist: metrics baseline, commands run, incident ticket INC-2025-084 link, runbook edits in progress.

nia: ack handoff. monitoring dashboards and alerts. please ping if anything else.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2025-084 created and linked to thread. Severity: P1. Timeline and logs uploaded to incident runbook.

sre-rotation: closing notes: create post-incident task to examine connection pooling defaults in service templates across apps. assign to platform-team.

alex: thx team — great quick mitigation. we'll schedule RCA tomorrow and include customer comms.

pagerduty: Incident PD12345 resolved (status: resolved) at 2050012387. :white_check_mark:
